/isEnrolledIn/ {
  # split student and rest
  line=$0
  sub(/^uni:/,"",line)
  split(line,a," ")
  student=a[1]
  # get everything after isEnrolledIn up to ";"
  n=split(line,b,"isEnrolledIn")
  courses=b[2]
  sub(/;.*/,"",courses)
  gsub(/[ .]/,"",courses)
  m=split(courses,c,",")
  grad="none"
  if (match(line,/hasGraduationDate "[^"]+"/)) { grad=substr(line,RSTART+20,RLENGTH-21) }
  for(i=1;i<=m;i++){ print student, c[i], grad }
}' | sort -k2,2 | awk '{print}'

for c in CS101 AI101 Math101 Math201 Physics301 Bio101 Eng202 EngUS302 STS101; do echo -n "$c: "; grep "isEnrolledIn" university_graph.ttl | grep -E "(^|[ ,])uni:$c([ ,;]|$)" | grep -v "hasGraduationDate \"2025" | grep -c "Student"; done
